response.overview: Brian, a struggling filmmaker and alcoholic, is determined to bring his dream slasher film to life. But as his substance use disorder takes over, his relationships crumble and his grip on reality deteriorates. Mentally breaking down during a film shoot, Brian descends into a hellish psychological nightmare war zone. To survive, he must confront his inner demon zombies—or be consumed by them. Most importantly, he must not allow the killer from his movie to stab his brain.
response.title: Brain Stab
